_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: reason
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('PURCHASE', 'DAMAGE', 'WASTAGE', 'MISSING', 'CORRECTION', 'OTHER'))

data.name: offers
constraints: CHECK (start_at IS NULL OR end_at IS NULL OR start_at <= end_at)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "auth_user_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "display_name" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "platform" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPSERT', "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" TEXT NULL, "last_pushed_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff_permissions" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "permission" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "permission"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "selling_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price_paise >= 0), "cost_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (cost_price_paise IS NULL OR cost_price_paise >= 0), "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0), "stock_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COUNT' CHECK (stock_unit IN ('COUNT', 'ML', 'GRAM', 'KG', 'NONE')), "low_stock_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USE_DEFAULT' CHECK (low_stock_mode IN ('USE_DEFAULT', 'CUSTOM', 'OFF')), "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER CHECK (low_stock_threshold IS NULL OR low_stock_threshold >= 0), "membership_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (membership_enabled IN (0, 1)), "member_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (member_price_paise IS NULL OR member_price_paise >= 0), "image_path" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "sku"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "selling_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price_paise >= 0), "cost_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (cost_price_paise IS NULL OR cost_price_paise >= 0), "stock_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock_quantity >= 0), "low_stock_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USE_DEFAULT' CHECK (low_stock_mode IN ('USE_DEFAULT', 'CUSTOM', 'OFF')), "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER CHECK (low_stock_threshold IS NULL OR low_stock_threshold >= 0), "membership_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (membership_enabled IN (0, 1)), "member_price_paise" INTEGER CHECK (member_price_paise IS NULL OR member_price_paise >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "sku"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "membership_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("membership_active" IN (0, 1)), "membership_fee_paise" INTEGER NULL, "whatsapp_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "receipt_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_paise >= 0), "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_paise >= 0), "payment_method" TEXT CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAID' CHECK (payment_status IN ('PAID', 'NOT_PAID')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "voided" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("voided" IN (0, 1)), "voided_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "receipt_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise >= 0), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "note" TEXT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reversed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reversed" IN (0, 1)), "reversed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise >= 0), "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SUPPLIES', 'UTILITIES', 'RENT', 'SALARIES', 'MAINTENANCE', 'MARKETING', 'TRANSPORT', 'MISC')), "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('CASH', 'UPI', 'BANK')), "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAID' CHECK (payment_status IN ('PAID', 'NOT_PAID')), "expense_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_paise >= 0), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_paise >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_sequences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (next_value >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id", "shop_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "movement_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (movement_type IN ('OPENING', 'SALE', 'PURCHASE', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT')), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity <> 0), "stock_before" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stock_before >= 0), "stock_after" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stock_after >= 0), "reason" TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('PURCHASE', 'DAMAGE', 'WASTAGE', 'MISSING', 'CORRECTION', 'OTHER')), "note" TEXT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "purchase_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_paise >= 0), "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_paise >= 0), "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "purchase_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "unit_cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_cost_paise >= 0), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_paise >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_sequences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "next_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (next_value >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id", "shop_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "offers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shops (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT CHECK (type IN ('PERCENTAGE','COMBO','BUY_X_GET_Y')) NOT NULL, "config_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "start_at" TEXT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (start_at IS NULL OR end_at IS NULL OR start_at <= end_at));
